581.title: Dances with Wolves
581.overview: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.

25797.title: Miss Minoes
25797.overview: A cat who turns into a young woman helps a journalist protect their town from a factory boss with an evil plan.

665669.title: Portrait of a Family
665669.overview: Baseball player Jung-gu and movie star Nam-mi are a celebrity couple who are blissfully happy in their careers and marriage. One day, a girl named Dong-ju shows up and the couple's lives are instantly destroyed. Seven years later, as Dong-ju gets involved in the death of a middle-school girl, Jung-gu and Nam-mi decide to fight a battle they have no chance of winning.

683205.title: The Legend Hunters
683205.overview: The story follows the team as they try to raid a tomb made by master tomb raiders. It is set partially in Russia and will involve scenes at Catherine Palace in St. Petersburg.

785157.title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
785157.overview: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

1002053.title: A Survivor's Tale
1002053.overview: 1542, the year of Jacques Cartier's second mission to Canada. Pregnant by a man other than her future husband, the expedition's commander, the young Marguerite de la Rocque is abandoned on a deserted island off the coast of Newfoundland with the man who raped her and his maid. She will remain there for two years, surviving hunger, cold, despair, and madness.

1016069.title: Rally - From Paris to the Pyramids
1016069.overview: This action-packed adventure for family audiences follows Reodor Felgen, a brilliant but eccentric inventor, and his two unlikely friends — Solan, a daring magpie, and Ludvig, a timid hedgehog — as they attempt to redeem themselves by competing in the legendary Paris-to-the-Pyramids rally. Equipped with their extraordinary racecar, Il Tempo Gigante, the trio embarks on a high-stakes journey through bustling Paris, the perilous Italian Alps, and the scorching Egyptian desert. With their home, friendship, and lives on the line, they must prove that ingenuity and determination can conquer any challenge.  A thrilling follow-up to The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix

1125701.title: Midwinter Break
1125701.overview: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

1138565.title: At Your Service
1138565.overview: A young mother and a police officer who finds herself in a predicament when deciding who to save - her family, her career, or herself.

1144965.title: Paper Flowers
1144965.overview: Based on a true story, USC graduate Shalin Shah leaves behind the expectations of his Indian-American family and his girlfriend Fiona to serve as a Peace Corps volunteer in Peru. But when a persistent cough leads to a devastating diagnosis of synovial sarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer, Shalin is forced to return home and confront a future he never anticipated. Surrounded by his family, Fiona, and his closest friends, he begins to reconsider what it means to live with purpose when time can no longer be taken for granted. As Shalin’s perspective deepens, his reflections on gratitude, love, and mortality inspire the essay “Thank You, Cancer,” which is published by HuffPost and goes viral with readers around the world. A devastatingly beautiful story of family, resilience, and the lasting impact of one life, Paper Flowers is a reminder to cherish the people we love and the moments that give life meaning. #SunsetsForShalin

1181125.title: The Day Iceland Stood Still
1181125.overview: When 90% of Iceland’s women walked off the job and out of their homes one morning in 1975, they brought their country to its knees and catapulted Iceland to the forefront of today's global fight for gender equality. Unexpectedly funny, laced with evocative animation and powerfully told by the women who lived it – this is the true story of 12 hours that launched a revolution.
1181125.trailerName: The Day Iceland Stood Still - trailer

1236677.title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
1236677.overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).
1236677.trailerName: BEST SERVED COLD: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades (2024) Trailer

1257413.title: The Traitor
1257413.overview: Hoping to become a great singer in Germany, a young dreamer named Ernst Schrämli finds himself drawn into underhand dealings. Determined to escape a suffocating environment that annihilates any kind of creative or artistic impetus, Ernst sells information about the Swiss army to a Nazi spy by the name of August Schmid, who charms and manipulates him. When Ernst’s crime is uncovered, he is sentenced to death for espionage and treason, becoming the first Swiss citizen to be executed.

1258181.title: A Woman's Life
1258181.overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

1272837.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
1272837.overview: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

1273221.title: Scary Movie
1273221.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

1274757.title: Forastera
1274757.overview: Cata will see her summer vacation disrupted by the absurd and sudden death of her grandmother, which only she witnesses. Her grief shifts when she casually turns to play pretend, transforming into the deceased. What begins with a game of dress-up will blur the lines of reality and family roles.

1278021.title: Bowels of Hell
1278021.overview: Malu is organising a gender-reveal party for a pregnant influencer – while dealing with her own grief, her persistent constipation problems and her adolescent transgender child (who disapproves of her job commission). At the condominium where Malu lives, some strange phenomena are unleashed in the home’s most private zone: the bathroom.

1278853.title: Woodwalkers 2
1278853.overview: For shapeshifter Carag and his friends Brandon, Holly, and Lou, a new school year begins at Clearwater High. But first, the Woodwalker Council must decide whether Carag's mentor and patron of the school, Andrew Milling, is guilty of attacking humans. Carag is in a dilemma: he wants to put a stop to Milling's actions, but Milling promises to take him to his true puma family if he covers for him before the council.

1279045.title: Volcelest
1279045.overview: Winter is here. To survive, Fuseline, the little ermine, forced by the lack of food, flees her wild environment and settles near an isolated farm and its chickens. Her arrival threatens the precarious existence of the man who lives there.

1279493.title: The Get Out
1279493.overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.
1279493.trailerName: The Get Out | Official Trailer (HD) | Vertical

1279941.title: Censor Addiction
1279941.overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

1287365.title: The Liberation
1287365.overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

1288069.title: Tenzing
1288069.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

1290821.title: Shelter
1290821.overview: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.
1290821.trailerName: Shelter | Official Trailer | Only In Theaters January 30

1297093.title: Quir
1297093.overview: There is a store in Palermo unlike any other called Quir, a place of love defying any convention. The owners are Massimo and Gino, who have been together for forty-two years, perhaps the longest-lasting gay couple in Italy. Their small leather goods store has become an important meeting place of the local LGBTQI+ scene – here people chat about their love stories or seek advice – fighting for acceptance in Sicily, a stronghold of patriarchal culture.

1312325.title: Parallel Consequences
1312325.overview: Max and his friends, Pedro and Bruna, discover a time machine and decide to test it. What begins as an adventure quickly turns into a nightmare when Pedro inexplicably tries to kill Max, who must repeatedly travel back a few seconds in time to survive and uncover the truth. Caught in an unstable timeline, the three friends confront dark truths about themselves, the weight of their choices, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to rewrite destiny.

1321861.title: Ghost Writer
1321861.overview: He has been staying in the town for three days. He seems to be investigating something, although nobody can tell exactly what. One evening, as he stands by the edge of the lake, she approaches him.

1323717.title: Confessions of a Brazilian Call Girl 2

1323909.title: Red Riding
1323909.overview: After her mother's overdose, teen Red Riding moves from London to her estranged grandmother's Scottish estate, where dark family secrets, missing children, and a monstrous wolf blur reality, forcing her to fight for survival.
1323909.trailerName: Red Riding | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1342341.title: Captain Sabertooth and the Countess of Grel
1342341.overview: Set sail for an exciting pirate adventure when Captain Sabertooth and Raven fight against Sibylla and her terrifying dragon in a battle that can only be won by courage, friendship and rat soup!
1342341.trailerName: CAPTAIN SABERTOOTH AND THE COUNTESS OF GREL | Trailer
1342341.original_title: Kaptein Sabeltann og Grevinnen av Gral

1342533.title: Catch the Wind
1342533.overview: A travelling Irish comedian (O’Donoghue) and a barmaid (Raison) find each other in the urban sprawl of New York City. When fate intervenes, they're confronted with a decision which will determine their destiny.
1342533.trailerName: Catch The Wind | Official Trailer | Romance | Drama

1386309.title: Censored
1386309.overview: Spain 1969. After the death of her brother, a young, dyslexic organist begins a forbidden love affair with an idealistic woman who pushes her to write a song and rebel against the highly censorious and conservative society ruled by the dictator Franco.

1388805.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
1388805.overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

1388869.title: Maar
1388869.overview: "MAAR" is an upcoming Assamese Feature Film to be Written and Directed by Aasish Dutta under the banner ABEYANCY™. Produced by Anjumoni Saikia Dutta, Original Score by Fardin Irfan, Music by Riyan Saikia and D.O.P Mrinal Jyoti Bora. Film is on Pre-Production state.

1400837.title: Other Mommy
1400837.overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

1408709.title: Not So Perfect Stranger
1408709.overview: After a traumatic divorce, a young and promising architect, Ava Westcott, returns to Niagara Falls to confront her nightmares, only to find herself the target of a disturbed local, Wyatt Ross, whose dark history and obsession threaten both their lives.

1417285.title: The Stain
1417285.overview: When Malee, a young woman with a dark past, is drawn by fate to an apartment where she must confront haunting memories from her childhood, she encounters Pran, a botanist, a tea blending master, and the founder of a Thai floral tea brand.
1417285.trailerName: ราคี THE STAIN | Official Trailer

1418821.title: Becoming Kim
1418821.overview: German filmmaker Susanne, married to a Korean man named Kim Jeong Rae, turns the camera toward her own intercultural marriage and family with both humor and tenderness. Blending vérité and performance, the film dives into the beautiful mess of love, identity, and cultural collision. Becoming Kim asks: How do we stay true to ourselves—while learning to love another?

1419973.title: Kiss Me My Ghost Friend
1419973.overview: When a young, down-on-his-luck director revives a forgotten opera in a crumbling, supposedly haunted theater, he discovers his biggest obstacle isn’t the leaky roof or his ex-girlfriend—it’s the charming, sharp-tongued ghost of a diva actress who died there 20 years ago.  As rehearsals spiral into chaos and an exorcist shows up with unfinished karma of his own, ghost and director form an unlikely bond—one filled with comedy, heartache, piano duets, and the wild backstage energy only theater kids and spirits could create.  Together, they just might finish the show that was never meant to open—and give each other the final curtain call they’ve been waiting for.

1424261.title: UK Holiday
1424261.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.
1424261.trailerName: BARI LAI LAI | Nepali Pop Song 2019 | RAJAN TIMILSINA | JANAKI PANT JOON | Ft  KUMUD PANT & SMRITI

1424965.title: Ice Skater
1424965.overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

1427653.title: Departures
1427653.overview: It’s instant chemistry when Benji encounters Jake at an airport departures gate. Their on-going relationship unfolds through intimate trips to Amsterdam, revealing a complex power dynamic.

1433157.title: Nature: The Call for Reconciliation
1433157.overview: Combining poetry, science and emotion, this film traces the history of life, from its cosmic origins to its evolution on our planet, through the wonders of biodiversity and the contemporary challenges it faces. Through spectacular images, Yann Arthus-Bertrand questions the paradoxes of our times and urges a collective transformation to reconcile humanity with nature.

1453317.title: Hari Ka Om
1453317.overview: Hari Prasad and his son Om are separated because of ideological differences. When Hari suffers a heart attack one morning and announces that he is going to die in six days, his wish to take his last breath at Kashi (Varanasi) with his elder son Om sets them on a destined journey to heal their dysfunctional relationship.

1460933.title: Angh
1460933.overview: In 1960s Nagaland, a proud Konyak chief struggles to protect his dying traditions when an American missionary arrives with promises of aid that threaten his people’s identity. As his wife’s health deteriorates and famine looms, he and his mute son must make an impossible choice between survival and staying true to their ancestral ways.

1461701.title: Foufo
1461701.overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

1464773.title: Borley Rectory: The Awakening
1464773.overview: In 1900, young Reverend Henry Bull and his sister, Kitty, are tasked with taking over the duties of their family home in Essex, a majestic Victorian mansion built on the site of an old monastery. Unaware of the sinister forces that lurk within, the pair are soon confronted by terrifying paranormal activities that threaten their loved ones. Desperate to protect themselves from the demonic intrusion, they call upon the services of a trusted family friend to investigate the origins of the vengeful ghosts which haunt their property. But these are spirits who will not rest, and Borley Rectory is doomed to gain a chilling reputation, as the most haunted house in all of Britain.

1465605.title: Cryptex
1465605.overview: A short philosophical satire that wanders between the absurd and the profound. From a silent bed stare to a prophetic lentil, Cryptex explores the rituals of modern existentialism — one cup of coffee and one book at a time.

1468229.title: Ernie & Emma
1468229.overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

1477317.title: Your Fault: London
1477317.overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

1479429.title: The Surgeon
1479429.overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

1483525.title: Possible Love
1483525.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

1495685.title: Despite the Night
1495685.overview: Months after a volcanic eruption, a cloud of ash still looms overhead, plunging much of northern Australia into a perpetual night. As a city empties, days bleed into nights, seasons vanish, and time begins to rot. Inside a quiet apartment, two brothers face the slow death of their world, and a faster one inside their home.

1502277.title: Interstate
1502277.overview: Set in 2009, a group of lost high school graduates embark on a road trip to find themselves before they enter the next chapter of their lives. However, their plans take a twist when both old and new drama emerges, threatening to break their fragile group bond.

1508101.title: For Love
1508101.overview: 30-year-old Anna seeks a stable foundation in her relationships but unknowingly repeats the manipulative patterns learned from her mother. When she crosses paths with a terminally ill patient and his devoted wife, Anna experiences a profound love that transforms her life.

1509381.title: Oradour
1509381.overview: Five days before the massacre at Oradour-sur-Glane , Philippe Gerbier, an officer in the Free French Forces , is parachuted in near the village . He is to lead a mission for the Resistance in preparation for the D-Day landings . There, he is reunited with Marie, his childhood sweetheart.

1519621.title: Dad Сan
1519621.overview: Viktor and Vera have been happily married for 20 years. They live in a large house with four children and a dog. Viktor is a successful top manager working in the chain store "Tomato&Co". And Vera, in order to take care of the children, gave up her career as a lawyer and spends her days spinning like a squirrel in a wheel. But one day, after a not very successful working day, Viktor declares that his job is much harder than her daily concerns about the family. Then Vera, in order to take revenge on her ungrateful husband, decides to take a leave from motherhood and goes on a vacation to Altai for ten days. Viktor is determined to prove that he can easily cope with simple household chores - but as soon as his wife leaves, his confidence begins to melt before his eyes.

1520453.title: New Jersey Devil
1520453.overview: 16-year-old Sophie is in the process of being adopted when a sinister force out of New Jersey folklore begins to torment her new family.
1520453.trailerName: NEW JERSEY DEVIL | 2026 Official Horror Movie Trailer

1520517.overview: Leo is only twenty, but his life is in black and white. His days always begin at 6:06, with odd jobs and an endless race to get his hands on his next hit. Taking drugs is not just an addiction; it’s a mental loop that keeps Leo trapped in an eternal déjà vu. Each time he tries to break out and escape, he’s always sent back to square one. Until he meets Jo-Jo, an enigmatic girl his same age who speaks French only and drives a camper like she’s on the run from something. Like him, she has deep scars. So Jo-Jo is not an easy way out, but it’s chaos that Leo needs. She has her own demons, and in some way, she can see into Leo’s fractured psyche. They drive off to Portugal together, through dusty, dreamlike landscapes, and there, their souls connect and finally speak the same language. Yet saving each other won’t be easy. Leo struggles with his dependency, while Jo-Jo seems to be one step away from dissolving into thin air – as if she were only there to show Leo the path to take.

1526917.title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
1526917.overview: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.
1526917.original_title: メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘

1532997.title: Dead Howling
1532997.overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

1541125.title: Make Zhonghe Great Again
1541125.overview: After encountering a standout colleague from a company event, Liu Ben, a section chief at Zhonghe Group's branch, embarks on a quirky professional journey with him, uncovering their true self-worth through chaotic workplace challenges.

1550533.title: Prima Donna
1550533.overview: Franziska Fürstenberg, a young director, begins to lose her sight, cancelling all her film projects. She asks her new assistant for help in finding a woman she saw in a dream.

1558405.title: The Abyss Beneath Us
1558405.overview: In search of answers, a troubled sleepwalker returns to his hometown to uncover the truth about his friend’s mysterious disappearance. As he ventures further, he descends into the darkest corners of his subconscious.

1561349.title: Only Known to Us
1561349.overview: Bound by a love kept in silence, a man struggles to remain seen within a family that once made him feel at home.

1566469.title: Bittersuite
1566469.overview: During a wedding at a hotel, Bety, a young receptionist, becomes intrigued by Vicki, a mysterious older guest. The night lures them to the pool, the tension builds, and everything ends with an unexpected disappearance.

1568517.title: Stuck On You
1568517.overview: A heartbroken manicurist accidentally takes a hitman's job, landing her in a deadly conspiracy where she must choose between saving her family or killing the man of her dreams.

1570053.title: Viral
1570053.overview: During a live broadcast, a digital performer finds herself strangely alone in front of only one viewer.

1576581.title: Someone's Daughter
1576581.overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

1585733.title: The House with Chimaeras
1585733.overview: At the peak of his career, famous Kyiv architect Władysław Horodecki is desperately fighting his own demons. At the same time, darkness emanated by the evil forces bringing menace to the city is gradually enveloping the entire Kyiv. To defeat evil, Horodecki has to take on the mission of creating an architectural Quadrangle of Good.

1588101.title: Ted Bunny
1588101.overview: The illegitimate son of serial killer Ted Bundy, raised around rabbits and crazed, goes on a killing spree...

1593157.title: Sandiwara
1593157.overview: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

1598661.title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
1598661.overview: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...
1598661.trailerName: The Playboy of the Western World | Audience Reactions | National Theatre

1601797.title: ¿Quieres ser mi novia?
1601797.overview: Javi and Lu's relationship faces dangerous territory as old and new temptations emerge: a young woman reigniting Javi's chemistry and a mature man pursuing Lu. Through humor, entanglements, and surprises, their love is tested.
1601797.trailerName: Will You Be My Girlfriend? - Official Trailer

1605125.title: Mythos
1605125.overview: An Anthology about Greek Mythology from the point of view of a college student who's trying to save his grade. Going through stories such as Pandora's Box, Nymph, Narcissus, Orpheus and Eurydice, and finally Theseus. Each one reflecting how Mythology might not be history, but examples of who we are as people.

1607621.title: Arjunan Per Paththu
1607621.overview: Arjunan, who witnessed his parents being killed by lightning in front of his eyes, cannot bear the shock and arrives in Chennai from his hometown Madurai. Arjunan, who joined a kayalang shop in Chennai, starts to love a woman. Before marrying that woman, he was a worker and wanted to become an entrepreneur. He gave away all the money he had saved up until then and bought an old Tata Ace and married the woman he loved. Arjuna happily starts driving the vehicle, thinking that his life has become as happy as he thought it would be. Arjuna, who has been facing constant problems with that old vehicle, realizes that he has been completely cheated in buying the vehicle. He brings together all those who have been affected like him and exposes all the frauds in buying and selling old vehicles, seeking justice for himself and all those who have been cheated like him.

1610181.title: Pressure Cooker
1610181.overview: Four women are pushed to their breaking point in Dhaka’s underbelly, where the only way to survive systemic exploitation is to stop being the prey and start being the threat.

1613893.title: Surplace
1613893.overview: On prom night, graduate Inga discovers that her boyfriend Kęstas is secretly helping a young stranger. As the night unfolds, the youth begins to sense that while they’re celebrating new beginnings, someone is searching for their own path into the future.

1614533.title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
1614533.overview: There are places that are meant to be just a stopover. But there are also places that make you wish you’d never come.

1617221.title: Nuptials
1617221.overview: A young couple on their honeymoon is forced to experience each other’s darkest desires. As the lines between reality and sanity blur, a sinister presence keeps them trapped in their bridal suite and tries to seduce them towards unbearable truths.

1620357.title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
1620357.overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

1621765.title: Only the Dead Fish Go with the Flow
1621765.overview: Camille is a 6-year-old boy, but Camille feels like a girl. For Carnival, Camille goes to school dressed as a princess despite the school’s refusal to recognize Camille as a girl. The principal summons her mother for a final confrontation.

1630661.title: Gaayapadda Simham
1630661.overview: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.
1630661.trailerName: Gaayapadda Simham - Official Trailer | Tharun Bhascker | JD Chakravarthy | Sree Vishnu

1631237.title: AVAV
1631237.overview: A young contract killer turns murder into a personal brand, inviting a documentary crew along and exposing how violence, content, and ambition feed off each other.

1634949.title: Lorne
1634949.overview: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

1636421.title: The Executor
1636421.overview: A reclusive heiress, bound by blood and burden, invites seven distant relatives to her decaying manor with whispers of inheritance. Beneath the promise lies a quiet cruelty- a gauntlet of secrets, temptation, and ruin. As family bonds unravel, she watches, choosing not just a successor, but a soul willing to bear the curse she can no longer carry. One will inherit the family estate, but only the heiress knows the hefty price they'll pay.

1638021.title: Freestyle
1638021.overview: In one charged morning practice, a kleptomaniac figure skater risks it all when her compulsions bleed onto the ice.

1640261.title: A Tale of Lost Times
1640261.overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

1641861.title: Pocket Mirror
1641861.overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

1643909.title: A Sua Frente
1643909.overview: Juraci, an elderly woman living a solitary life in her apartment, sees her routine transformed by the arrival of Ícaro, a migrant student, in the apartment across the hall.

1646213.title: AMER D'I
1646213.overview: Isaiah is a young man who decides to leave his family and friends to live and wander the streets of Paris after a painful past event.  Amidst encounters, ghosts, drugs, and self-destruction, Iz will plunge headlong into the capital.

1646341.title: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait
1646341.overview: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.

1647493.title: Baby Love
1647493.overview: A female MMA fighter on the brink of self-destruction finds a lifeline in a court-ordered equine therapy program, leading her to confront her past and redefine her future.

1648197.title: Тоже мне любовь
1648197.overview: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. While trying to make the evening special, Anya finds herself quietly unsettled by the upcoming wedding and the dynamics of Lina’s relationship. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

1649029.title: Sacred Way, 21 km

Following the traces of the ancient route, the diverse landscape and brief encounters with its current inhabitants reveal the different faces of the world’s oldest Sacred Way.

1650181.title: Chaali Din
1650181.overview: Chaali Din is an adaption of best selling punjabi novel of the same name. This gripping story by Gurpreet Dhugga delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships over a transformative 40-day journey. The book explores themes of love, loss, redemption, and self-discovery through vivid storytelling and well-drawn characters. With its gripping narrative and profound insights, this work captures the essence of life’s challenges and triumphs.

1651973.title: Clean Slate
1651973.overview: A woman confesses her biggest secret to the man she loves at the most inopportune time.

1652101.title: A casa que levo no peito

1660549.title: Carla and Her Legs

1661829.title: Smoke
1661829.overview: A man comes in from the smoke, and sets the world into a chaotic, psychotic state.

1663557.title: Archaeologies of the future
1663557.overview: Can we imagine an archaeology of the future? An unearthing of objects that have not yet been used, a reconstruction of societies that have not yet come to dance. And yet, traces guide an erratic movement from which all our rhythms seem to draw. There is, within archaeology, a visceral drive to reconstruct myths that might serve us as shelters—against which to contrast forms of community, of everyday life, of living.

1667205.title: Night King Director’s Cut
1667205.overview: The long-awaited director’s cut, with 30 minutes of unrevealed and breathtaking highlights!  The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, Foon (Dayo Wong), despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades.  To make things worse for Foon, the club’s new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V (Sammi Cheng)! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good.  To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

1669061.title: Pasakalye
1669061.overview: Brotherhood versus Duty. Two childhood friends will have the greatest ride of their lives as they find themselves up against each other. Who will rule the streets?

1688005.title: Carefree Head
1688005.overview: Murat, who lives in Istanbul, decides to return to his hometown of Cappadocia after being fired from his job. As he plans to start a new business there, his path crosses with his cousins Bedri and Fehmi, who are trying to escape the consequences of a crime they committed. However, the carefree spirit wandering around the town will both prevent Bedri and Fehmi from escaping and support Murat in establishing his new venture.

1690501.title: Zampano
1690501.overview: When his father's old circus company comes back in town, Zampano see's it as a chance to get back on a flying trapeze and to leave with Nina, the trapezist he's in love with. But his father reminds him he has vertigo.

1690949.title: Lau Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna
1690949.overview: Lau Kumud Hidyo Hero Banna is an inspiring music video about dreams, friendship, and the journey of becoming a hero. Kumude leaves his home in Dang with big dreams in his heart and travels to Kathmandu to become a hero. On the way, he meets his two close friends who support him and help change his style with black sunglasses, black jeans, a tough jacket, and stylish black Dingo shoes. Looking smart and confident, Kumude walks proudly like a real hero. During the journey, he meets a kind tempo rider girl who supports and encourages him. Their adventure becomes difficult when the tempo tyre gets punctured on the road. Later, a helpful truck driver gives Kumude a ride towards Kathmandu. 1692421.title: James: Getting Away with It

As we follow Karen's journey through the film we discover who is the killer and what are the true motivations behind the murders.

1698629.title: Christmas En Pointe

Samantha, a former ally and co-creator of TechLink, returns to the lifeless city to confront Markus and free the minds held captive. Battling through illusions and memories, she faces her former friend in a brutal, reality-warping showdown. To save humanity, Samantha must destroy the system from within — risking her life to restore what TechLink stole: free will.

With no clear idea of how they go there and no way out, they are forced to confront not only their circumstances but also each other.

1712069.title: Not Only Dogs Lick

One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.

1712517.overview: A ballet dancer from Macedonia comes to Mačkat, on Zlatibor, to meet his future wife's family. The differences in customs and mentalities lead to a series of hilarious but also emotional moments.

1716229.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier

1719557.title: The Living Dragon
1719557.overview: For more than half a century, Yasuaki Kurata has been one of the most prominent and singular Japanese actors in international action cinema. After becoming a major star in Hong Kong during the Golden Age of kung fu films - appearing alongside such icons as Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Jet Li and Donnie Yen - Kurata now marks both the 60th anniversary of his acting career and his 80th birthday with an ambitious and deeply personal new project, "The Living Dragon."  Structured as an anthology of three interconnected stories, the film brings together leading action directors Koichi Sakamoto, Kenji Tanigaki and Yuji Shimomura - all former members of the Kurata Action Club, who went on to earn their own fame in Japan and abroad. Moving between realism, fantasy and memory, the stories they've written for their sifu revolve around aging, unrealized dreams and the enduring spirit of those who continue to devote themselves to cinema.

1720261.title: Deniz Göktaş: Ölü Deniz
1720261.overview: In Göktaş's second attempt to get himself into trouble, he tries to make sense of his fame as a comedian. As more friends leave Turkey due to political uncertainties, his audience keeps growing. Each encounter with political figures and famous intellectuals reminds him where he truly belongs. He studied psychology to solve all his problems, but coming to terms with Turkey's history cost him more than he expected. Everything feels connected, yet there is a disconnected head you simply cannot unsee.  Recorded on June 1st at the Harbiye Open Air Theater, Istanbul.

1721669.title: FbG

Luckily algorithm has her back, but is it’s advice trustworthy? After all, algorithm loves nothing more than a postable love story.

1726149.title: Addiction

Exhausted and disillusioned, he starts to lose sight of why he worked so hard in the first place.. As his addiction tightens its grip, his reality begins to fracture. Without the substance, his mind spirals-distorting his perception and isolating him from the world around him. Soon, he starts seeing a dark, shadowy version of himself lurking in the distance... watching, waiting, and slowly getting closer. What begins as an escape turns into a psychological nightmare, as the figure grows impossible to ignore-an eerie manifestation of his unraveling mind, and a haunting reflection of the path he's chosen.

1727685.title: Whirlwind
1727685.overview: On the outskirts of town, in a small house beneath a hill, Bela lives in the quiet rhythm of her daily household routines. Yet just as truth has many faces, so too does its opposite, and Kiita gradually comes to see—and accept—that the lie that has protected his world has another face of its own.
1754757.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 노래가 끝난 후 After the Song | 비전 - 아시아

1754949.title: The Wayans Bros. Reunion

This special takes a look at the show’s origin and evolution through candid interviews with the cast and original directors, featuring classic clips, behind‑the‑scenes stories, and the brothers’ unfiltered commentary on how their unique comedic style shaped every episode. Packed with never‑before‑seen moments and genuine reflections, the reunion highlights everything fans loved about The Wayans Bros. while staying true to the show’s signature humor and energy.

1761925.title: Flowers of the Earth
1761925.overview: "Water lives in our bodies," a Kaiowá poet once said. "It evaporates into the air, becomes a cloud of love, falls as rain, sprouts the buds, blooms the flowers. We are Nature." For the Guarani-Kaiowá of Mato Grosso do Sul, there is no line where the body ends and the land begins. The earth is their skin, the tree their umbilicus, the mountains the bones of a living mother. But for over a century, that mother has been fenced, burned, mined, and poisoned, her children pushed onto slivers of the territory that once held them all. The film listens to the elders who remember the forest before the farmers came, before the native were clear-cut and the living land was carved into square plots of a single endless crop.

1765701.title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story

1765701.trailerName: Lifetime's Robin Roberts Presents Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story trailer

1767173.title: Lamina
1767173.overview: David spends his days sanding scars out of other people’s marble and wood, making the past look brand new again. Nights he sits outside his ex-wife’s loft like a man waiting for a ghost that never quite arrives. Then one barroom massacre changes everything. A stranger pulls him out of the slaughter a second before the shooting starts, almost like he’d seen it coming.  Now David is becoming unstuck. Moments stutter. Hours repeat. Reality folds in on itself. The stranger offers no explanations, only grim little jobs he calls the Moments. Some things, it turns out, can never be restored.

1767365.title: Ghun Gaon
1767365.overview: Shanaya, a wildlife photographer, travels alone to the remote village of Ghun Gaon to photograph a rare black leopard. However, she soon discovers a far more sinister and unsettling presence lurking deep within the jungle.

1768389.title: A Quiet Man
1768389.overview: An intimate portrait of Romain Zaleski, an industrialist, philanthropist, and art collector who for years has flown under the radar. He left home with practically nothing but today, he is France’s fourth richest person with a net worth estimated at several billion euros. The fascinating and twisted paths that led Zaleski to acquire his remarkable fortune ran through Poland, France, and Italy.

1769157.title: Twenty-Three Thousand Frames of an Incident
1769157.overview: Twenty-Three Thousand Frames of an Incident  I made this film entirely through my own feelings and experience, with a mind filled with uncertainty and anxiety.  This film was recorded exactly twenty minutes after the first explosion on the first day of the war.  I was on my way home with the other students from art school when I opened my phone’s camera and started recording.  Twenty-three thousand frames of those moments.
1769157.original_title: Twenty-Three Thousand Frames of an Incident

1770949.title: PRELUDIO
1770949.overview: ‎A brief overture to introduce you to "The Spring Wound." I didn't want to reveal too much; the fact that I shot with a cartridge nearly 40 years old worked fortuitously in my favor, in a way.

1771781.title: The Shrinking Island
1771781.overview: Constantly covered and unveiled by the tide, the “Shrinking Island” is home only to hermit crabs - except for when human tourists try to leave their mark.

1772549.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
1772549.overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

1774533.title: Heaven's Door
1774533.overview: A woman tries to make sense of her relationship progressing by letting her favorite movie say the words she can't while she grapples with someone from her past.

1777733.title: Work, Create, Repeat
1777733.overview: Kira Cummings, a pyrography (woodburning) artist from Jackson, Mississippi, embodies persistence. To fuel her creative fire, she’s had to juggle as many as three jobs while chasing her dream of making a living from her art.
